---
title: "Web app, gateway and REST API"
description: "Multi-user access with roles, live updates and the REDCap Data Entry Trigger."
---

The web app suits a team that works on one study at the same time. It has
three layers:

```
browser ──HTTPS──> FastAPI gateway :8080 ──> R engine (plumber) 127.0.0.1:8000 ──> REDCap
                    users and roles, WebSocket push, /det endpoint
```

The **R engine** listens on localhost only and accepts requests only when
they carry the gateway's shared secret. The **gateway** authenticates each
person with a personal API key, attaches their name and role to every
request (for the audit trail), pushes changes to every open browser over a
WebSocket, and receives REDCap's Data Entry Trigger. The **frontend** is
plain JavaScript with no build step.

## Run it

```powershell
pip install -r web/gateway/requirements.txt
cd web; .\run.ps1          # Linux/macOS: ./run.sh
```

On first run, `data_manager` and `statistician` keys are printed once. Add
people with:

```bash
python web/gateway/manage_users.py add <name> <dm|stats|monitor|pi|viewer>
```

## Roles

| Role | Can |
|---|---|
| `dm` | queries, rules, cuts, randomisation set-up, locks, coding, deviations, write-back, DRW sync |
| `stats` | read, raise analysis queries, comment |
| `monitor` | read, raise queries, verify SDV, log deviations |
| `pi` | read, randomise, e-sign (re-enters their key) |
| `viewer` | read only |

The roles separate duties deliberately: data managers cannot mark SDV, and
only data managers see the randomisation allocations.

## REDCap Data Entry Trigger

In REDCap, go to **Project Setup → Additional customizations → Data Entry
Trigger** and enter:

```
https://<your-host>/det?token=<CDMSTAT_DET_TOKEN>
```

Each form save then re-exports that one record, re-runs the rules, and
pushes the change to every open browser.

## REST API

The same functions are available directly. Through the gateway, the paths
are prefixed with `/api/` and need `Authorization: Bearer <key>`.

| Area | Endpoints |
|---|---|
| Project | `GET /summary`, `GET /metadata`, `POST /sync`, `POST /det`, `GET /sync/history`, `GET /schema/history` |
| Data quality | `GET /issues`, `GET /rules`, `POST /rules` |
| Queries | `GET /queries`, `POST /queries`, `POST /queries/raise-from-rules`, `POST /queries/{id}/transition`, `POST /queries/{id}/comment`, `GET /queries/{id}/audit`, `POST /writeback` |
| REDCap DRW | `GET /drw/status`, `POST /drw/enable`, `POST /drw/sync`, `GET /drw/links` |
| Analysis | `GET /fields/numeric`, `GET /scatter`, `GET /variables`, `GET /table1`, `GET /trend`, `POST /fit` |
| Data cuts | `GET /cuts`, `POST /cuts`, `POST /cuts/{id}/signoff`, `GET /script` |
| CDMS | `GET/POST /randomization...`, `GET /sdv`, `POST /sdv/plan`, `POST /sdv/verify`, `GET/POST /locks`, `POST /locks/{id}/unlock`, `GET /signatures`, `POST /esign`, `GET /coding`, `POST /coding/run`, `POST /coding/approve`, `GET/POST /deviations`, `POST /deviations/{id}/close`, `POST /deviations/check-windows` |
| Oversight and export | `GET /metrics/sites`, `GET /metrics/enrollment`, `GET /sdtm/{domain}`, `GET /export/odm`, `GET /activity` |

```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" https://cdmstat.example.org/api/table1?event=baseline_arm_1
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
     -d '{"record_id":"55","event":"week_12_arm_1","field":"hba1c","message":"Please verify"}' \
     https://cdmstat.example.org/api/queries
```

For production (HTTPS, services, secrets, backups), see
[Validation and deployment](validation-deployment.html).
